title: Kingdom size
summary: Max clans per kingdom, so one kingdom cannot take every clan on the server.

sections.heading: Setting a limit
steps: Open the Settings page and find Max clans per kingdom in the Kingdoms group.
Type the most clans one kingdom may have. The ruling clan counts too. 0 means no limit.
Tick Count mercenaries to count mercenary clans as well, so a full kingdom cannot hire more.
Press Save settings. The server picks it up within a few seconds, even while it runs.

sections.heading: What a full kingdom cannot do
steps: Players cannot join it as vassals, and with Count mercenaries not as mercenaries either.
Its ruler cannot recruit more lords. The player sees why when the barter is refused.
AI clans do not choose to join it or defect to it.
Clans already in the kingdom stay. New kingdoms, rebellions and marriages work as before.

sections.heading: The settings file
steps: The limit is kept in coodsz-server-tools.json next to server-config.json, in Documents, Mount and Blade II Bannerlord, CoopData, DedicatedServer.
It holds maxClansPerKingdom and countMercenaries. You can also edit it by hand.
Each refusal is one line in the server log, starting with Coodsz Server Tools.
sections.tip: Pick a number a little above the biggest kingdom at the start, so every kingdom can still grow a bit.
